name: B.R.B.
description:
Deploy a Battle Rebirth Beacon that revives a fallen ally and periodically produces armor packs and rocket jet packs.

    CASTINGProjectile (Deployable)
    HEALTH150
    DURATION300s (5 minutes)
    MAX REVIVE DISTANCE50m
    PACK UPGRADESOne upgrade is generated every 3s in fixed locations. Repeats: Armor Packs ×3, then Rocket Pack ×1 • Armor Pack: 25 Bonus Health (does not decay) • Rocket Pack: Up to 28m Jump Height
    REVIVE TIMING3.4s total (1.4s to queue fallen ally + 2s revival animation)
    REVIVE RULES• Beacon cannot be reclaimed once an ally is queued • Revive continues even if Rocket dies • Revive cancels if beacon is destroyed during the 3.4s
    COOLDOWNMaximum (40s): • Ally gets revived • Enemy destroys the beacon • Max duration is reached  Minimum (5s): • Reclaimed at full health • Destroyed by environment/mission vehicle • Self-destructs on failed deployment  Dynamic (Damaged & Reclaimed): • 5s base + 0.25s per 1 HP damage • Example: 45 damage = 16.25s cooldown
    SPECIAL EFFECTBeacon is immediately reclaimed if Rocket dies
